steps.description: Use your <color=#f4a641ff>Grappling Hook</color> to descend safely to the ground

quests.title: Craft and Equip a Scanner Tool

steps.description:
You need to build a <color=#f4a641ff>Scanner Tool</color> to start gaining <color=#f4a641ff>Knowledge</color> from the world around you.

First test that your <color=#f4a641ff>Salvage Tool</color> still functions.

<color=#f4a641ff>Salvage</color> metal from <color=#f4a641ff>Raw Metal Deposits</color>. Break away the outer layer to find the <color=#f4a641ff>Ore</color> inside.

TIP: Don't forget to use your <color=#f4a641ff>Grappling Hook</color> to reach deposits on the underside of the island.

Great work, now that you have enough raw metal you can <color=#f4a641ff>Craft</color> a <color=#f4a641ff>Scanner Tool</color> from your inventory.

Open your inventory to get started.
Next select your <color=#f4a641ff>Scanner Tool</color> schematic.
Drag the metal in your inventory into the schematic's <color=#f4a641ff>Component Slots</color>.
With the <color=#f4a641ff>Component Slots</color> full, all that is left to do is <color=#f4a641ff>Craft</color>.
To equip your <color=#f4a641ff>Scanner Tool</color> you'll first need to open the character tab in your inventory.
Finally, you'll need to <color=#f4a641ff>Equip</color> your <color=#f4a641ff>Scanner Tool</color> by dragging it into its slot on the character tab.

quests.title: Unlock the Reviver network
quests.completionDescription: You are now connected to Foundation's Revivers!

steps.description: Now that you have a <color=#f4a641ff>Scanner Tool</color> you'll need to use it to scan <color=#f4a641ff>Databanks</color> to gather <color=#f4a641ff>50 Knowledge</color>. Scan the terrain to know how many databanks can be found in this island.

wrappers.description: JUMPER - Already Learned Revival Chamber Interface

steps.description: Open your inventory

wrappers.description: JUMPER - Already Learned Revival Chamber Interface
JUMPER - Already Learned Revival Chamber Interface

steps.description: Unlock the Revival Chamber Interface in your Knowledge Tree to be able to use the respawner network that will connect you to the rest of Foundation!

quests.title: Access the Revival chamber located at the center of the island

steps.description: You can now enter the <color=#f4a641ff>Revival Chamber</color>, head to the middle of the island either solo or with friends that you want to remain close to.

wrappers.description: Enter the Revival Chamber at the middle of the island

steps.description: Interact with the platform inside the Revival Chamber to <color=#f4a641ff>activate</color> the Revival Chamber Interface, and teleport - <color=#f4a641ff>together with other players on the platform</color> - to The Wilderness.

Welcome to Foundation! Your next step should be to unlock <color=#f4a641ff>Shipbuilding</color>. Find and <color=#f4a641ff>scan</color> more Databanks to gain <color=#f4a641ff>25 more Knowledge</color>.

wrappers.description: Scan databanks to gain 25 more Knowledge

steps.description:
You've gathered enough ancient Knowledge to learn <color=#f4a641ff>Shipbuilding</color>. 
Open your inventory.
From your inventory, select the <color=#f4a641ff>Knowledge Tab</color>
Learn <color=#f4a641ff>Shipbuilding</color> from your Knowledge Tree to unlock what you need to start building ships.

wrappers.description: Learn Shipbuilding from the Knowledge Tab

quests.title: Build your first ship solo or with a crew.
quests.completionDescription: Well done, time to set sail!

steps.description:
All ships start with a frame, which are built at <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyards</color>. Gather the materials to craft a <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard</color>, or register with one that already exists.

TIP: if you want to use another Traveller's Shipyard, you'll need to ask for their Shipyard Code.
Craft a <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard</color> from your <color=#f4a641ff>inventory</color>, and equip it to your <color=#f4a641ff>hotbar</color>.
Select the <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard</color> in your <color=#f4a641ff>hotbar</color>, then find enough free space on an island to <color=#f4a641ff>place</color> it.

Now that you have access to a <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard</color>, you can use it to build a <color=#f4a641ff>ship frame</color> - the foundation on which all ships are built. Gather the resources you need, and build a frame.
Next you'll need an <color=#f4a641ff>Assembly Station</color>. Gather the materials required to build one.
Open your inventory and craft an <color=#f4a641ff>Assembly Station</color>, to begin building the parts that make up your ship.

You've crafted your <color=#f4a641ff>Assembly Station</color>, now you need to equip it to your hotbar, and place it.

TIP: Place your <color=#f4a641ff>Assembly Station</color> within the bubble around your <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard</color> so that you can pick up what you make with it.
Like the <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard</color> before it, now that you've placed your <color=#f4a641ff>Assembly Station</color> you must interact with it to start building.

wrappers.description: JUMPER - Is Registered to Personal Reviver

steps.description: Now that you have access to an <color=#f4a641ff>Assembly Station</color> you can start building ship parts! Start off by crafting a <color=#f4a641ff>Personal Reviver</color>.

wrappers.description: JUMPER - Is Registered to Personal Reviver

steps.description:
Use your <color=#f4a641ff>Shipbuilding Tool</color> to pick up your new <color=#f4a641ff>Reviver</color>, and place it on top of your ship.

TIP: All players registered to a shipyard can <color=#f4a641ff>Grapple</color> to its surrounding <color=#f4a641ff>Shipyard Bubble</color> to help them move around their ship while they're building it.

wrappers.description: JUMPER - Is Registered to Personal Reviver

steps.description:
Now that it's placed on a ship, <color=#f4a641ff>interact</color> with your <color=#f4a641ff>reviver</color> to register it to your character. This will let you <color=#f4a641ff>respawn</color> on the ship if you die, and it also makes you an <color=#f4a641ff>owner</color> of this ship.

TIP: The <color=#f4a641ff>Personal Reviver</color> is the only ship part you have to register to.

Feel free to get creative, but all a ship needs to fly is a <color=#f4a641ff>Sky Core</color> to give your vessel some lift, a <color=#f4a641ff>Helm</color> to steer, and a <color=#f4a641ff>Sail</color> to get moving.

TIP: Weight and balance matter when building a ship. Try starting simple.

quests.title: Craft a Torch to light up the dark

steps.description: A Torch will help you light up dark caves. To craft one you will need <color=#f4a641ff>Cloth</color> and <color=#f4a641ff>Wood</color>, both of which can be salvaged from <color=#f4a641ff>trees</color>.
You have gathered enough materials to craft a Torch, but first you'll need some cloth. Open your inventory.
To craft <color=#f4a641ff>Makeshift Cloth</color> from the <color=#f4a641ff>Plant Fibers</color> that you gathered, first select its schematic.
Drag your <color=#f4a641ff>Plant Fibers</color> into the <color=#f4a641ff>Makeshift Cloth Schematic's</color> Component Slot.
When all of a schematic's Component Slots are filled with materials, an item can be crafted. <color=#f4a641ff>Craft</color> some cloth.
Now that you have cloth and wood you can craft a <color=#f4a641ff>Torch</color>; select its schematic.

wrappers.description: JUMPER - Have enough Plant Fibers for Cloth

steps.description: Drag your <color=#f4a641ff>Makeshift Cloth</color> and <color=#f4a641ff>Wood</color> into their component slots on the <color=#f4a641ff>Torch Schematic</color>
Craft yourself a <color=#f4a641ff>Torch</color>.
Equip your <color=#f4a641ff>Torch</color> to your <color=#f4a641ff>Hotbar</color>
With your <color=#f4a641ff>Torch</color> now equipped to your <color=#f4a641ff>Hotbar</color>, you can wield it by pressing its hotkey.
You're injured, to heal you'll need some food. <color=#f4a641ff>Daccat Berries</color> are the most basic form of food, and can be salvaged from <color=#f4a641ff>tree trunks and branches</color>.
You've got some Berries, open your inventory.
Equip your berries to your <color=#f4a641ff>Hotbar</color> to be able to eat them.
Close your inventory and <color=#f4a641ff>wield</color> your berries.
Use your equipped berries to eat them.
